items.title: Trump's waiver of Graham law curbs comes as a relief to India, other Russian energy buyers
items.summary: Trump’s waiver of Graham bill provisions could leave US navigating competing priorities: sustaining pressure on Moscow, containing domestic fuel costs and avoiding unnecessary trade disputes with major energy buyers. For India, the suspension offers immediate relief from a potentially damaging tariff escalation, but similar future threats have not disappeared.

items.title: Peak power demand exceeds 250 GW through most of September
